summary: Dual-channel Hall effect encoder board, a thin PCB that mounts on the back of a Romi mini plastic gearmotor. A 6-pole magnetic disc sits on the extended rear motor shaft, which passes through the central hole of the board. A 6-pin 0.1 in header row is along one edge. The kit contains two boards, two discs and header pins. The part is modeled as one board, with the disc excluded.

mountingSurfaces.description: Back face of the board, soldered against the rear face of the gearmotor. The motor's rear shaft passes through the central hole.
Header edge with a 6-position, 2.54 mm pitch pad row for signal and power connections. It extends about 7 mm past the motor edge.

notes: Dimensions are estimates. The text states that the encoder fits within the 11.5 mm × 22.5 mm motor cross section on three sides and extends 7 mm past the fourth side. That gives a board about 22.5 mm wide and about 11.5 + 7 = 18.5 mm long. The 1.6 mm thickness is the standard PCB thickness and is assumed. Header pads are on a stated 2.54 mm pitch. The 4 mm center hole is estimated visually and is not stated. The 1 mm pad hole size is assumed. Hole positions are approximate. The slotted corner mounting or solder holes are visible but are not modeled. The magnetic disc (about 8 mm diameter, 2.5 mm thick) and the header pins are separate parts and are not included in the bounds. The shaft is stated to protrude 5 mm beyond the back of the motor.
